title: Xanthe and the Ember
author: Ivo Nakamura
blurb: Mara Oyelaran, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
